notes: Lines: a line set to Inside is now placed the way Figma draws it, entirely on one side of the line with round or square caps kept within its length. This covers the test frames' lines, caps and dashed line.
testFocus: Send the test frames again and compare Line 0°, 30° and −60°, Round caps, Square caps and Dashed line against the Figma Reference.

Resume: start sending all five frames, close the Frame Bridge panel in After Effects partway through, reopen it (Window ▸ Extensions ▸ Frame Bridge), then click Resume in Figma. Only the frames that weren't built yet should arrive.
